answer: Weight grows with age: an identity must sign a heartbeat every epoch, and its reward weight rises 1/30 per consecutive epoch. 100 fresh sybils together weigh 3.3 mature accounts, and a farm needs 30 epochs of upkeep to reach full weight, 30x slower than one honest key. A public beacon logs heartbeats; a violet flag marks gaps and a pearl badge marks 30-epoch veterans. Weakness: pre-aged accounts can be bought; fix: cap weight at 5 veterans per funding source.
